story.summary: Browse and Read Blog Content from Webook Blog
story.description:
Story Title:
Browse and Read Blog Content from Webook Blog
Story ID:
BLOG-US-001
User Story:
As a Webook user or visitor, I want to browse, open, and read blog content on the Webook Blog page so that I can discover articles, updates, travel/entertainment content, and Webook news relevant to my interests.

url = https://webook.com/blog/
Acceptance Criteria:
AC-01 – Access Blog Landing Page
User can navigate to the Webook Blog page successfully.
Blog landing page loads without broken UI or server errors.
Blog page displays the main blog layout, including article listings / featured content sections.
AC-02 – View Blog Categories / Topics
User can view available blog categories / topics displayed on the blog page.
Categories such as Experiences, Travel and Tourism, Adventures, Food, Music, Sport, Concerts, or Webook News are visible where applicable.
Clicking a category opens the corresponding filtered category page / listing if category navigation is supported.
AC-03 – View Blog Article Listings
User can see blog article cards / article entries on the landing page or category page.
Each article card displays the relevant content metadata where available, such as:
article title
category / tag
article image / thumbnail
publish date
short preview / excerpt if present
AC-04 – Open Blog Article Detail Page
User can open a blog article from the listing page.
Article detail page loads successfully.
Full article content is displayed correctly, including title, body content, media, and article metadata where available.
Navigation from listing page to article detail page works without errors.
AC-05 – Blog Search / Discovery (if available)
If a blog search bar or search feature is available, the user can search for blog content using a keyword.
Relevant matching articles are displayed for valid search terms.
If no matching content is found, a proper no-results / empty-state message is shown.
AC-06 – Blog Filtering / Category Navigation
User can navigate between blog categories / topic sections if filtering is supported.
Selecting a category or section updates the visible blog content accordingly.
The selected category / topic context is reflected correctly in the page content.
AC-07 – Related / Featured Content Display
If featured posts, latest posts, popular posts, or related content sections are present, they are displayed correctly.
User can open those linked articles successfully.
AC-08 – Error Handling / Empty States
If blog content fails to load, the page should display a user-friendly fallback / error state instead of a broken screen.
If a category or search result has no content, an appropriate empty-state message is shown.
AC-09 – Accessibility & Usability
Blog page links, article cards, category links, and interactive controls are keyboard accessible.
Blog content is readable and page navigation is usable across desktop and other supported layouts.
Focus order is logical for category links, search (if available), and article cards.
Non-Functional Expectations:
Blog landing page and article pages should load within acceptable performance limits.
Blog content should render correctly without broken images/layout.
Navigation between blog listing and article detail pages should be reliable across supported browsers/devices.
Scope Covered:
Blog landing page
Category/topic navigation
Article listing cards
Article detail page navigation
Search/filter behavior if present
Featured/latest/news sections
Error and empty-state handling
